title: With the farmers of Annavaram
description: During the Annavaram Girivalam in 2026, Swamiji spent time with farmers, offered his blessings, and greeted them with affection. These simple moments reflect humility, warmth and compassion in his life as a Shankaracharya.
credit: Photographs, event account, location and year shared by the Foundation
